moremax.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
moremax.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

moremax.us.title: The Nun
moremax.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (Horror, Thriller) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Scream
moremax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

moremax.us.title: Girls Trip
moremax.us.description: Best friends Ryan, Sasha, Lisa and Dina are in for the adventure of a lifetime when they travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush. (Comedy, Drama, Adventure) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Mid90s
moremax.us.description: In the 1990s Los Angeles, a 13-year-old spends his summer navigating between a troubled home life and a crew of new friends he meets at a skate shop. (Comedy drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Enemy
moremax.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs. (Thriller) - 2013

moremax.us.title: My Dead Dad
moremax.us.description: Young burnout Lucas is notified that his estranged father has passed away and has left him an apartment complex in Los Angeles. Lucas meets the eclectic tenants, and soon discovers his father was a different man than the one he knew. (Drama) - 2021

moremax.us.title: Isle of Dogs
moremax.us.description: When, by executive decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, 12-year-old Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior-Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire Prefecture. (Animated, Comedy, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
moremax.us.description: Superstar LeBron James and his young son, Dom, get trapped in digital space by a rogue AI. To get home safely, LeBron teams up with Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against the AI's digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad. (Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy, Animated) - 2021

moremax.us.title: Teen Titans GO! See Space Jam
moremax.us.description: The Teen Titans gang crosses paths with the Nerdlucks from Space Jam. (Animated, Action, Adventure, Comedy) - 2021

moremax.us.title: Masterminds
moremax.us.description: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him. (Comedy, Action) - 2016

moremax.us.title: The Internship
moremax.us.description: After old-school salesmen Billy and Nick find themselves downsized, Billy decides that, despite their complete lack of technological savvy, they should work for Google. The friends somehow manage to finagle internships at the Internet giant and promptly head out to Silicon Valley. Viewed with disdain by most of their fellow interns, Billy and Nick join forces with the rest of the misfit "nooglers" to make it through a series of competitive team challenges. (Comedy) - 2013

moremax.us.title: Night on Earth
moremax.us.description: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach de Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest. (Comedy drama, Drama) - 1992

moremax.us.title: Papillon
moremax.us.description: The epic story of Henri Papillon Charrière, a safecracker from the Parisian underworld who is framed for murder and condemned to life in the notorious penal colony on Devil's Island. Determined to regain his freedom, Papillon forms an unlikely alliance with convicted counterfeiter Louis Dega, who in exchange for protection, agrees to finance Papillon's escape. (Adventure, Historical drama, Biography) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Ocean's 11
moremax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
moremax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
moremax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
moremax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

moremax.us.title: Mickey 17
moremax.us.description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. (Science fiction, Comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Opus
moremax.us.description: A journalist is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants, she gets caught in the middle of his twisted plan. (Thriller, Horror, Comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Time Bandits
moremax.us.description: Young history buff Kevin (Craig Warnock) can scarcely believe it when six dwarfs emerge from his closet one night. Former employees of the Supreme Being (Ralph Richardson), they've purloined a map charting all the holes in the fabric of time and are using it to steal treasures from different historical eras. Taking Kevin with them, they variously drop in on Napoleon (Ian Holm), Robin Hood (John Cleese) and King Agamemnon (Sean Connery) before the Supreme Being catches up with them. (Fantasy) - 1981

moremax.us.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
moremax.us.description: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian. (Romantic comedy) - 2002

moremax.us.title: The Man
moremax.us.description: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer. (Comedy, Action) - 2005

moremax.us.title: Tomb Raider
moremax.us.description: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Robin Hood
moremax.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Historical drama) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Hangover Part II
moremax.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: The Daytrippers
moremax.us.description: Eliza D'Amico's seemingly idyllic marriage to Louis changes dramatically when she discovers what she believes to be a love letter to him from someone else. Going home to her family for comfort, Eliza sets out with her mother, father, sister and her sister's boyfriend in the family car to track down and confront Louis. Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process. (Comedy) - 1996

skysport4.nz.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn - Nedbank Gravel Burn: Stage 2 Hls
skysport4.nz.description: Highlights from Stage 2 of the Nedbank Gravel Burn, a 7-day, 750km gravel cycling race from Graaff-Reinet to Shamwari. Riders take on demanding loop routes, iconic Karoo landscapes, and fierce gravel racing. (Episode)

skysport4.nz.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn - Nedbank Gravel Burn: Stage 3 Hls
skysport4.nz.description: Highlights from Stage 3 of the Nedbank Gravel Burn, a 7-day, 750km gravel cycling race from Graaff-Reinet to Shamwari. The longest stage of the race delivers mountain passes, rolling terrain, and relentless competition. (Episode)

skysport4.nz.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn - Nedbank Gravel Burn: Stage 4 Hls

skysport4.nz.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn - Nedbank Gravel Burn: Stage 5 Hls
skysport4.nz.description: Highlights from Stage 5 of the Nedbank Gravel Burn, a 7-day, 750km gravel cycling race from Graaff-Reinet to Shamwari. Fast gravel, remote landscapes, and accumulated fatigue test riders deep into the race. (Episode)

skysport4.nz.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn - Nedbank Gravel Burn: Stage 6 Hls
skysport4.nz.description: Highlights from Stage 6 of the Nedbank Gravel Burn, a 7-day, 750km gravel cycling race from Graaff-Reinet to Shamwari. Riders transition from open Karoo plains to bushveld terrain on the road to Shamwari. (Episode)

skysport4.nz.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn - Nedbank Gravel Burn: Stage 7 Hls

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E21 Episode 21 Laura starts the show in the historic Prahran Market making a simple and heart-warming Potato and Leek Soup.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Featuring Matt Keenan, Gary brings together fresh, lively flavours in a menu of poke bowl with salmon, cucumber salad, and a Greek style fetta and greens pie served with Yemeni sauce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E83 Bang For Your Buck Prepare to taste the savings as Adam, musician Sarah McLeod and chef Grant King give you bang for your buck!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E2 Mashup Recipes Get the best of both worlds when Mary mashes ideas together to get wacky dishes like Caesar salad roast chicken and taco meatball skillet.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E22 Foraging Adventures As a child, Lidia would forage for ingredients that were not produced in the courtyard, garden, or field. Now she makes chestnut mushroom ragu, asparagus gratin with fried egg, and clam soup.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 Stilton Stilton has been known as the King of English cheeses for more than two centuries, and unlike its traditional cousins, it has never been copied elsewhere.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E2 Eating Johannesburg Johannesburg- the gateway city to exploring South Africa. In this episode Warren indulges in the vibrant international flavours and surrounds of the Sandton neighbourhood.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Portofino In Portofino, glamour meets simplicity. Against this picture-perfect backdrop, Luana sets out to meet the people who bring this legendary village to life.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Bornholm, Denmark Tareq takes the ferry out to Bornholm, a Danish island that has seen its share of invaders and reluctantly took part in WW2.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E4 Alex Rogers: Crumbed Barra Fillets With Salad, Steamed Barra With Ginger And Soy, Curry Barra Soup This episode is a salute to the fighting freshwater and saltwater barramundi. Alex Rogers whips up a simple dish with one of his favourite fish.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E13 Bbq's Maggie and Simon celebrate the BBQ and show viewers how to get the most from it - be it for starters, main courses and even desserts.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E27 Episode 27 Dietitian Simone Austin joins Laura in the market to make a dish that not only tastes great but is also good for your gut health: Braised Greens and Spelt Pasta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E27 Green Gazpacho And Giant Grilled Shrimp Rachael loves gazpacho, a cold soup made from raw vegetables that is perfect for warm Italian summers.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn Bbq
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Dee Why Beach Hayden grew up surfing the break at Dee Why Beach, and Hayden finishes up his BBQ Special with recipes featuring a side of salmon, pork belly and a whole butterflied chicken.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Not Your Butter Chicken
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Food Is Sewa Shiva’s profession of hospitality interweaves with her own mother’s commitment to the Indian concept of Sewa (being of service to others or the act of giving).

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E22 Episode 22 Laura makes pearl couscous puttanesca and a batch of chocolate truffles; Catherine makes poached tomato salad.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 of Season 1 Featuring Dane Simpson Gary Mehigan serves up a vibrant mix of comfort and flavour with a spiced saffron latte, a hearty spaghetti bolognese, spaghettini with creamy smooth feta pesto, and a fragrant.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E51 Episode 51 On today's episode of Everyday Gourmet some simple but delicious recipes are shared; Chicken Broth with Old Bread Dumplings and Baked Fish with Basil Mayo.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E84 Strictly Bbq With movie star Paul Mercurio in the kitchen, the cue is for strictly BBQ. His co-stars? Adam and chef Rosy Scatigna!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eva Pau's Asian Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 Episode 6 Eva makes the weekend extra delicious with dishes perfect for sharing. She starts with Hong Kong Style French Toast, getting children involved to create golden, syrupy bites everyone will love.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Memory Bites With Matt Moran
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Danielle Cormack Chef Matt Moran and actor Danielle Cormack celebrate the unlikely influence of iconic TV Chefs from New Zealand, Hudson and Halls, recreating flamboyant dishes that shaped her childhood and career.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Batch From Scratch: Cooking For Less
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 East Yorkshire Joe Swash and The Batch Lady, Suzanne Mulholland help the Powell family in Hull tackle their hectic mealtimes, showing them how to save time, cut costs and enjoy stress-free meals!

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E13 Tamales And Iguana, Oaxacan Style Chef Tony Bourdain explores Mexico's Oaxaca region where he tastes toasted grasshoppers and other delicacies.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E14 So Much Vodka, So Little Time Tony tries his hand at ice-fishing, drinks a lot of vodka, feasts on Russian foods, eats smoked fish and ends the outing with a dip in the outdoor cold pool.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E3 Mare Of Cheesetown Cheese is on the short list of Mary's true loves, so it's time for another round of all-cheese everything! App, mains, and dessert, oh my.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E23 The Vegetable Patch Lidia works in her garden; she reminisces the lessons that her grandma taught her about her vegetable patch. She makes a country salad as well as green beans with new potatoes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E7 USA Will Studd visits the finest cheese shops in down town New York to find out what's driving this extraordinary change, before visiting upstate Vermont, where he meets a new generation of cheese makers.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Wild Kwa-Zulu Natal The wild northeast coast of South Africa is like nothing you've seen. And it's here Warren will find himself romanced by empty beaches, rugged open oceans, and waterways filled with wild hippopotamus.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Santa Margherita Ligure Santa Margherita Ligure reveals itself as a town where life is enjoyed at every hour of the day. Luana happily loses herself in its lively streets, discovering one of Liguria's most beloved tradition.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Jokkmokk, Sweden Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E5 Maria Morgan: Ox Tail Stew & Vegie Bake Marie Morgan draws on the Kimberley history of station and mission days. Marie shares with us a family recipe that takes us back to a simpler time.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E14 An Autumn Party Maggie introduces Simon to her outdoor wood-fired oven, and he uses it to make some pottery with a very special meal inside. Autumn is Maggie's favourite season.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E28 Episode 28 Laura uses local Adelaide Hills produce to make her delicious Red Wine Poached Pears. Chef Charlie Carrington and farmer Catherine Velisha join forces to showcase spring onions with a unique Za'atar.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E28 Albanian Pizza With Muscles And Pasta Rachael's friends, Leida and Veina, are showing how to make three types of Albanian Pizza, a rustic dish made with phyllo dough filled with beef, chicken, and potatoes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Little Manly Point Hayden sets up the BBQ in the park at Little Manly Point and has a tasty range of dishes ready to go: butterflied chicken, salmon flatbreads, and rotisserie mushrooms.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Not Your Butter Chicken
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Ready To Roti This episode centres on the resilience of South Asian women throughout the hardships of migration.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E23 Episode 23 Laura makes some muesli bars and spaghetti alla Nerano; chef Masa cooks some seafood yaki udon; Catherine makes kangaroo salad.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Episode 3 Guest Paul Mercurio presents flavour-packed recipes including lamb backstraps with artichokes and capers, open pita with grilled haloumi, and roasted lamb rack.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E52 Episode 52 We've all had bacon and eggs at some point, but have you had them baked all together in a pan?

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E85 Have A Go Eco-entrepreneur Lottie Dalziel and Chef of the Year Jo Barrett join Adam to demonstrate how to have a go at their favourite food fundamentals.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Family Dineasties
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Kylie Kwong and Kevin La cook and dine with the family chefs from Sun Ming Parramatta, Tang Bou and Hangang as well as dropping by Kevin's Dad's much loved grocery store in Bonnyrigg.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigella Express
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E9 Speedy Gonzalez It's fast, fabulous and packs a big flavour punch. Nigella's cooking Latin influenced food the express way. For the family: a fabulous ever-ready sweet corn chowder, topped with tortilla chips.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Tuscany Tuscany is the birthplace of the Renaissance and world-class art, architecture and culture. It's also produced some of the finest wines and dishes in the history of Italian cuisine.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Lemon Chilli Chicken With Turmeric Rice Learn to cook a signature dish at Island Dreams Cafe and an all-round family favourite. Alimah Bilda shares a version with a punchier, thicker sauce that coats the chicken and rice.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E15 A Pleasing Palate Tony attempts to dispel the myth that all English food is disgusting and over-boiled. Tony tries Nose to Tail Eating, and explores traditional fare at Pie and Mash Shoppes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E16 My Hometown Favourites Tony gives us an intimate tour of the New York City foods he loves - sturgeon and bagels, fluke ceviche, braised veal cheek, authentic cheese and, of course, a hotdog.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E85 Have A Go Eco-entrepreneur Lottie Dalziel and Chef of the Year Jo Barrett join Adam to demonstrate how to have a go at their favourite food fundamentals.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E5 Karlstad: Food From Two Seasons Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vanern's shores and in Varmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E14 An Autumn Party Maggie introduces Simon to her outdoor wood-fired oven, and he uses it to make some pottery with a very special meal inside. Autumn is Maggie's favourite season.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E3 Mare Of Cheesetown Cheese is on the short list of Mary's true loves, so it's time for another round of all-cheese everything! App, mains, and dessert, oh my.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Family Dineasties
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Kylie Kwong and Kevin La cook and dine with the family chefs from Sun Ming Parramatta, Tang Bou and Hangang as well as dropping by Kevin's Dad's much loved grocery store in Bonnyrigg.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigella Express
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E9 Speedy Gonzalez It's fast, fabulous and packs a big flavour punch. Nigella's cooking Latin influenced food the express way. For the family: a fabulous ever-ready sweet corn chowder, topped with tortilla chips.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Tuscany Tuscany is the birthplace of the Renaissance and world-class art, architecture and culture. It's also produced some of the finest wines and dishes in the history of Italian cuisine.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Lemon Chilli Chicken With Turmeric Rice Learn to cook a signature dish at Island Dreams Cafe and an all-round family favourite. Alimah Bilda shares a version with a punchier, thicker sauce that coats the chicken and rice.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E15 A Pleasing Palate Tony attempts to dispel the myth that all English food is disgusting and over-boiled. Tony tries Nose to Tail Eating, and explores traditional fare at Pie and Mash Shoppes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E16 My Hometown Favourites Tony gives us an intimate tour of the New York City foods he loves - sturgeon and bagels, fluke ceviche, braised veal cheek, authentic cheese and, of course, a hotdog.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E85 Have A Go Eco-entrepreneur Lottie Dalziel and Chef of the Year Jo Barrett join Adam to demonstrate how to have a go at their favourite food fundamentals.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Jokkmokk, Sweden Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E23 The Vegetable Patch Lidia works in her garden; she reminisces the lessons that her grandma taught her about her vegetable patch. She makes a country salad as well as green beans with new potatoes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E7 USA Will Studd visits the finest cheese shops in down town New York to find out what's driving this extraordinary change, before visiting upstate Vermont, where he meets a new generation of cheese makers.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Wild Kwa-Zulu Natal The wild northeast coast of South Africa is like nothing you've seen. And it's here Warren will find himself romanced by empty beaches, rugged open oceans, and waterways filled with wild hippopotamus.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Santa Margherita Ligure Santa Margherita Ligure reveals itself as a town where life is enjoyed at every hour of the day. Luana happily loses herself in its lively streets, discovering one of Liguria's most beloved tradition.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E5 Karlstad: Food From Two Seasons Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vanern's shores and in Varmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E5 Maria Morgan: Ox Tail Stew & Vegie Bake Marie Morgan draws on the Kimberley history of station and mission days. Marie shares with us a family recipe that takes us back to a simpler time.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E14 An Autumn Party Maggie introduces Simon to her outdoor wood-fired oven, and he uses it to make some pottery with a very special meal inside. Autumn is Maggie's favourite season.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E28 Episode 28 Laura uses local Adelaide Hills produce to make her delicious Red Wine Poached Pears. Chef Charlie Carrington and farmer Catherine Velisha join forces to showcase spring onions with a unique Za'atar.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E28 Albanian Pizza With Muscles And Pasta Rachael's friends, Leida and Veina, are showing how to make three types of Albanian Pizza, a rustic dish made with phyllo dough filled with beef, chicken, and potatoes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Little Manly Point Hayden sets up the BBQ in the park at Little Manly Point and has a tasty range of dishes ready to go: butterflied chicken, salmon flatbreads, and rotisserie mushrooms.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Not Your Butter Chicken
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Ready To Roti This episode centres on the resilience of South Asian women throughout the hardships of migration.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E23 Episode 23 Laura makes some muesli bars and spaghetti alla Nerano; chef Masa cooks some seafood yaki udon; Catherine makes kangaroo salad.

RedbullTV.us.title: ADVENTURE: Motorkite Dreaming – Flying Across Australia
RedbullTV.us.description: Aiden Glasby and Daryl Clarke embark on an adventure across Australia with modest microlight equipment.

RedbullTV.us.title: SURF: Munch – Noa Deane's Epic Australian Mission
RedbullTV.us.description: Noa Deane hits Australia for heavy slabs, punts and air sections with Ozzy Wrong in an wild surf adventure.

RedbullTV.us.title: SKATE: Greetings From - Johannesburg
RedbullTV.us.description: Explore the skateboarding scenes thriving throughout Jo'burg in 2023, from Westdene DIY to the Island Gals and the mighty Skate Society Soweto.

RedbullTV.us.title: SURF: Chumbo: Made for Big Wave Surfing – Balancing Act
RedbullTV.us.description: Big wave surfer Lucas Chianca balances the thrill of surfing with the joys and challenges of being a parent.

RedbullTV.us.title: ACTION: For Reals – Legendary Red Bull Moments
RedbullTV.us.description: Red Bull athletes fly through Tower Bridge, swing from balloons and slackline epic heights just for thrills.

RedbullTV.us.title: KAYAKING: Whitewater Kayaking with Nouria Newman
RedbullTV.us.description: Aniol Serrasolses joins Nouria Newman to explore Patagonia's Rio Blanco from a glacial lake to the ocean.

RedbullTV.us.title: SKATE: Skate Tales – Madars Apse's Global Journey
RedbullTV.us.description: Madars Apse travels to Brazil to skate with double-amputee and Birdhouse Skateboards pro Felipe Nunes.

RedbullTV.us.title: ATHLETICS: Limit/less – Adventuring Against the Odds
RedbullTV.us.description: Triathletes Natascha Badmann and Claire Danson meet in Switzerland to go on a special adventure together.

RedbullTV.us.title: ACTION: Red Bull Flugtag – Hunting Human-powered Flight
RedbullTV.us.description: The influence of past winners is evident as a new generation of homemade flying machines takes to the skies.

RedbullTV.us.title: BIKE: Matt Jones: The Impossible Gap – Extreme MTB
RedbullTV.us.description: MTB rider Matt Jones aims to jump between two moving trucks in a nano-second. Watch him prepare for the feat.

RedbullTV.us.title: ACTION: I Attempted the Impossible Hill Climb
RedbullTV.us.description: Creator Zac Alsop discovers what it really takes to master one of the most challenging hill climbs imaginable.

RedbullTV.us.title: BIKE: Unrideable – Hard Enduro Behind the Scenes
RedbullTV.us.description: At Red Bull Erzbergrodeo, 2023's winner Manuel Lettenbichler faces rising star, Mitch Brightmore.

RedbullTV.us.title: BIKE: Unrideable – Hard Enduro Behind the Scenes
RedbullTV.us.description: After losing his spot Teodor Kabakchiev, Wade Young returns to Red Bull Romaniacs to prove he still belongs.

RedbullTV.us.title: BIKE: Unrideable – Hard Enduro Behind the Scenes
RedbullTV.us.description: Champion Manuel Lettenbichler suffers a setback as his challengers fiercely race to take his lead away.

RedbullTV.us.title: BIKE: Unrideable – Hard Enduro Behind the Scenes
RedbullTV.us.description: Billy Bolt returns as Mario Román chases his dream, the rivals race literally from sea to sky in Türkiye.

RedbullTV.us.title: BIKE: Unrideable – Hard Enduro Behind the Scenes
RedbullTV.us.description: Drama hits the 2024 season finale. Will Lettenbichler win the title again or lose it all to a fierce rival?

RedbullTV.us.title: BIKE: Everything to Gain – Kate Courtney at Cape Epic
RedbullTV.us.description: Setbacks behind her, Kate Courtney chases the Rainbow Jersey at a mountain bike race in South Africa.

RedbullTV.us.title: BIKE: 25 Years of Red Bull Rampage Winning Runs
RedbullTV.us.description: Every winning run from 2001 to 2025 at Red Bull Rampage. What it took to win back then, and what it takes now.

RedbullTV.us.title: BIKE: Red Bull Hardline 2026 Canada – Highlights
RedbullTV.us.description: Best moments from the first Red Bull Hardline Canada, where riders conquered the most extreme downhill race.

RedbullTV.us.description: Four-time Formula One world champion Sebastian Vettel delighted over 60,000 fans with a comeback in an F1 car.

RedbullTV.us.description: Experience the 2014 Formula One racing season with Carlos Sainz as he strives to become a top driver. Meet the team behind his success and feel his highs and lows.

RedbullTV.us.title: MOTORSPORT: Secto Rally Finland 2026 – Highlights
RedbullTV.us.description: Wide gravel roads snake through Finnish forests at the fastest rally on the calendar. Watch highlights here.

RedbullTV.us.title: MOTORSPORT: Vodafone Rally Portugal 2026 – Highlights
RedbullTV.us.description: Watch highlights from the rally that features varying conditions from dusty gravel roads to technical twists.

RedbullTV.us.title: Rally Islas Canarias 2026 Highlights
RedbullTV.us.description: Extremely fast and technical tarmac stages criss-cross the Spanish Island of Gran Canaria. Watch highlights.

RedbullTV.us.description: Follow the Hungarian national hero Laura Horváth as she takes on the inaugural World Fitness Project season.

RedbullTV.us.description: Get ready for full-throttle action as the best drifters descended on Latvia to be crowned the 'King of Riga'.

RedbullTV.us.description: Discover what makes HYROX, the indoor fitness competition, a test of strength, endurance and determination.

RedbullTV.us.description: In the off-season athletes balance life with ambition, while building strength to compete with the Elite 15.

RedbullTV.us.description: Footballer Sadiq Elfitouri and OCR champ Ida Mathilde make a debut, as the sport draws pros from all fields.

RedbullTV.us.description: New faces challenge the veterans, and expert coaches fuel the growth of the women’s field.

RedbullTV.us.description: Since 2009, Red Bull Cliff Diving World Series has featured great competitions and inspiring rivalries.

RedbullTV.us.description: Rhiannan Iffland journeys to the Australian Outback and uncovers more than she expected.

RedbullTV.us.description: Watch Catalin Preda and David Colturi become the first people to dive into the wadis of Saudi Arabia.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E12 Marvellous Maths: 2 Eddie joins Abi and Luke in the lab to experiment with balancing different objects, it's all about weight and size. Together, they invent a pattern game with hopping, jumping, spinning and even jazzy hands!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S16 E2 The Way of the Wild Walkers When Peter creates a wild and adventurous trail for Scoop Dooley to follow, they both end up getting lost.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zip And The Tiny Sprouts ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E38 8 Bit Zip Zip is loving his new video game, but he's ignoring his friends in order to play it all day and night! Can the Sprouts teach him about moderation?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Woohoos!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E13 Squiggle Riddle The Woohoos think a mysterious artist has painted a beautiful squiggly pattern on Scotty's roof. They learn that slugs make slime trails which help them to go anywhere they want, and to find each other.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Guess How Much I Love You
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E24 Blossoms It's spring blossom season and the pretty pink blossoms that come floating down the stream remind Big Nutbrown Hare of a magnificent cherry tree from his youth.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miffy and friends ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E69 The Lucky Feather When Ko finds a pretty feather and a lucky thing happens, Miffy convinces him that it must be a good luck charm. So when a gust of wind blows it away, Ko is convinced his luck is gone too!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Sound Collector
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E33 Roar Power The Sound Collector hears a roar from the Wildlife Park that is bigger than the lions!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E36 Safety Pants When Mayor Sourdough asks Pants to 'watch Nanna Ribbit', Pants didn't think he'd have to chase her around all day, while she goes off on daring adventures.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BeddyByes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E38 Good to Share BaBa enjoys sharing with friends, but is disappointed when they have shared everything and are left with nothing. Luckily MeMo and BaBa's other kind friends enjoy sharing back.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mini Kids
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E8 What animals does Fantus face today?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E47 Neighbours Bluey needs Mum's advice on dealing with a troublesome neighbour, when the serenity of her couch cushion playhouse is threatened by Bingo's growing stable of animals.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E17 Mountains Fizzy and Suds explore famous mountains and the science of tectonic pressure before creating handmade binoculars for their own creative climbing adventures. Majestic!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E11 Tiny Forest Clarence drops by a little country school with a dream of planting a native! It's time to dig, plant and grow. The grand finale? A community celebration bursting with proud junior gardeners!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E14 Row, Row, Row Your Boat Caterina and Anthony find a rowboat in the Wiggly Kitchen. The Wiggles sing 'Row, Row, Row Your Boat' and then it's time for the Wiggle Town Dancing Water Police to help with the problem of the day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 Bouncy Boots Absorbing Man steals the power of bouncy boots.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mecha Builders
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E42 Measure For Measure Marwyn attempts to make Pretty Big City's largest cookie, but to do so, he'll need a lot of Mecha help.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends: Big World! Big Adventures!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S24 E13 The Inventor's Spectacular Bridge When the Rickety Old Bridge collapses, trapping Toby and Henrietta on the other side of the ravine, Inventor Ruth is asked to build a new one.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E28 George's Woolly Hat George has a new hat and Mummy Pig is determined that George doesn't get it muddy when visiting Grandpa and Granny Pig.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E25 Canal Boat It's Captain Daddy Dog's birthday and Mummy Dog surprises him with the gift of a boat trip, which isn't quite what he expected.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kiri and Lou
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E23 What's Art For? Small paints Kiri and Lou's portraits, while Pants invents something very useful.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E11 Frozen Peas It's so cold in the Valley that the Pea-Rexes risk becoming frozen! Ginger needs to keep them warm and skating around the frozen lake might just help!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E32 Tadpoles Holly takes some frogspawn home from class to look after, but is surprised when the frogspawn has turned into tadpoles by morning. Soon there are lots of little frogs for Holly to look after!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E23 Bad Luck, Good Luck Flower is convinced she's cursed with bad luck after breaking a mirror. But with the help of Flour and her friends, she discovers that luck isn't something you find, it's something you make.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E5 Museum Mayhem Lab Rat and Ginny learn what makes their art special.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E50 The Compass Caper Santiago is on a mad dash to get his compass back after it's nabbed by Bonnie Bones and Sir Butterscotch.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks: Power Heroes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E37 Pharoah's Mountain Pharaoh Boy steals An Yu's Staff.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E1 The Octonauts And The Trigger Fish When he's carried away by a cyclonic waterspout, Kwazii finds himself stranded in the open ocean with a triggerfish who's made her home underneath the damaged Gup-B.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E18 The Show And Tell Badge Duggee has something really interesting to show at the clubhouse. Can the Squirrels find some other interesting things to share?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E12 Dad Rescue When Frizzy's dad gets into trouble in the mountains, Frizzy steps up to lead the rescue mission and save the day!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S14 E12 Go Team Wildman A team building exercise to carry a massive log through the woods turns into a rapid river rescue for Moose and the Wildmen of Pontypandy!

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E11 The Stones of Blood: Part 3 As the blood hungry Ogri close in, the Doctor launches a desperate attempt to rescue Romana from hyperspace.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E12 The Stones of Blood: Part 4 The Doctor releases two alien justice machines from imprisonment who sentenc him to death. Meanwhile Romana urgently searches for clues that will reveal Vivien Fay’s true identity.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E13 The Androids of Tara: Part 1 Arriving on Tara, Romana locates the fourth segment of the Key to Time with ease, but is captured by the scheming Count Grendel who wants the throne of Tara for himself.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E14 The Androids of Tara: Part 2 Grendel kidnaps Prince Reynart and seems set to be chosen as Tara’s monarch when Reynart fails to arrive at his coronation. But the Doctor has a plan to scupper the Count’s scheme.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E15 The Androids of Tara: Part 3 While Romana makes her escape from the castle, the Doctor is lured to a meeting with an android duplicate of her that is programmed to kill him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E2 The Ribos Operation: Part 2 Garron is attempting to trick the Graff Vynda-K into buying the planet Ribos, but the jethrik that is vital to his plan is really the first segment of the Key to Time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E3 The Ribos Operation: Part 3 The Doctor and Romana's search for the first segment of the Key to Time is hampered when the Graff Vynda-K takes them prisoner.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E4 The Ribos Operation: Part 4 Pursued into the catacombs by the Graff and attacked by the ferocious Shrivenzale, the Doctor and Romana struggle to stay alive and find the first segment of the Key to Time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E5 The Pirate Planet: Part 1 In search of the second segment of the Key to Time, the Doctor and Romana travel to the planet Calufrax. But they find that a completely different planet has taken its place.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E6 The Pirate Planet: Part 2 Still in search of the missing planet, Calufrax, the Doctor and Romana encounter the telepathic Mentiads and Zanak’s ruler, the half man, half robot Captain.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E7 The Pirate Planet: Part 3 The Doctor has discovered the sinister truth about Zanak and solved the mystery of the missing planet. On the Bridge, the Doctor meets the real ruler of Zanak.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E8 The Pirate Planet: Part 4 The Doctor and Romana join forces with the Mentiads to prevent the Captain and Xanxia from using Zanak to consume the Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E9 The Stones of Blood: Part 1 The Doctor and Romana track the third segment of the Key to Time to the vicinity of an ancient stone circle on Earth. But sinister forces are at work and the stones hide a secret.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E17 The Power of Kroll: Part 1 Tracing the fifth segment of the Key to Time to the third moon of Delta Magna, the Doctor and Romana are soon caught up in the conflict between humans and the Swampies.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E18 The Power of Kroll: Part 2 The Doctor arrives in time to save Romana from being sacrificed to the bogus god, Kroll. But it’s not long before the very real Kroll makes its terrifying appearance.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E19 The Power of Kroll: Part 3 With the giant, squid-like Kroll awake and angry, the Swampies are eager to appease their god by using the Doctor and Romana as sacrificial victims.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E20 The Power of Kroll: Part 4 With Kroll on the rampage, the Doctor and Romana are appalled to discover that Thawn intends to fire a rocket at the creature which will also kill the Swampies.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E1 Destiny of the Daleks: Part 1 The TARDIS lands on the old Dalek homeworld of Skaro where the Doctor and the newly regenerated Romana discover that someone is digging deep beneath the planet’s surface.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E2 Destiny of the Daleks: Part 2 Romana is captured and interrogated by the Daleks whilst the Doctor meets the Movellans who are equally interested in discovering exactly what the Daleks are searching for.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E3 Destiny of the Daleks: Part 3 Davros has awoken from his centuries long slumber and is taken prisoner by the Doctor before the Daleks can reach him. But the Daleks will stop at nothing to recover their creator.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E5 City of Death: Part 1 While on holiday in Paris, the Doctor and Romana experience a time distortion. At the Louvre, someone is taking an unusual amount of interest in the Mona Lisa.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E6 City of Death: Part 2 The Doctor and Romana become the reluctant guests of Scarlioni who is planning to steal the Mona Lisa despite having six Mona Lisas hidden in his cellar – all of them genuine.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E7 City of Death: Part 3 Count Scarlioni is revealed to really be Scaroth, last of the Jagaroth and is funding the construction of a time machine – but for what purpose?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E8 City of Death: Part 4 Scaroth intends to travel back in time to save his own people from destruction. But the Doctor can’t allow him to succeed as it would mean the destruction of all life on Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E9 The Creature from the Pit: Part 1 The Doctor and Romana follow a distress signal to the jungle world of Chloris. The planet is ruled by the ruthless Lady Adrasta who takes the Doctor prisoner.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E10 The Creature from the Pit: Part 2 The Doctor has escaped Adrasta’s wrath by jumping down the pit into the last remaining metal mine on Chloris. But the pit is also the home of a monstrous creature.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E11 The Creature from the Pit: Part 3 In the pit, the Doctor establishes contact with the creature and begins to suspect that all is not as it seems.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E12 The Creature from the Pit: Part 4 With Erato now able to communicate, the truth of Adrasta’s scheming is revealed but a terrible retribution has already been put in motion.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E13 Nightmare of Eden: Part 1 A terrible hyperspace accident results in two starships becoming locked together. The Doctor arrives and discovers that the incident may have also released a deadly menace.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E14 Nightmare of Eden: Part 2 The Doctor and Romana are horrified to discover that Tryst has been storing real lifeforms in his CET machine and that someone is smuggling the dangerous narcotic, Vraxoin.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E15 Nightmare of Eden: Part 3 The terrifying Mandrels have escaped from Eden and are attacking everyone aboard the Empress. The Doctor and Romana, accused of being smugglers, are pursued by customs officers.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E16 Nightmare of Eden: Part 4 The Doctor solves the mystery of the drug smuggling racket and the culprits are revealed. But unless the Doctor and Romana act quickly, the villains will escape justice.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E17 The Horns of Nimon: Part 1 With the TARDIS disabled in order to undergo repairs, the Doctor is powerless when Romana is kidnapped by a battleship which is on its way to Skonnos and the formidable Nimon.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Learn A Word ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E15 Saw Learn to spell and write the word Saw. This series shows an easy way to learn the basic words used in English, based on the Australian National Curriculum.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Alphablocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E7 Ned Alphablock E searches for a home for Ned the frog. They have no luck with a BED, a DEN, or a PEN belonging to a cross HEN. Then a VET suggests somewhere WET. Ned loves his pond!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Colourblocks ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E15 Rainbow The Colourblocks attempt to solve a rainbow puzzle with the help of new friends Indigo and Violet. Learn about the seven colours of the rainbow with the Colourblocks.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E15 Ten Pin Tournament The Numberblocks have a bowling tournament, but which team is going to win the trophy? Their friend Rekenrek adds up the scores!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E18 Attack of the Hiccups! The Shuffler's hiccups are shuffling things - including the only book that can cure her!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E9 How Does It Work? Speaker Today Maddie is using her senses to see and hear! She visits a speaker factory to understand what happens when we listen to music from a speaker.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E15 Mini Pond Tammy, Maeve and Yeshi explore a watery wonderland and create their own mini ponds with soil, rocks, sticks and different plants that thrive in fresh water. Don't forget the mermaids!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Operation Ouch! Do Try This at Home
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E2 Reaction Times Dr Chris and Dr Xand examine reactions and show how the senses affect reaction times in today's DO try this at home experiment.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Horrible Science ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E10 Aliens Invade, Everest Gets Taller and The Great British Fart Off Dr Big Brain regrets taking 'The Vantastic Beast' for a spin, the hosts regret signing up to present The Great British Fart Off, and Gladiators Viper and Dynamite help Agent Goodie.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Built to Survive
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Wet And Wild Rainforests In the heat and humidity of the rainforest Phil reveals the survival adaptations of the elusive tree kangaroo, the colourful cassowary and the lethal scrub python.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Ages Of Ice Portrait of a Scientist Shorts ᴺᵉʷ
BtN Newsbreak
ABCMESydney.au.description: E195 Episode 195 Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E8 South Coast George heads to the south coast to meet an eccentric father and son duo, who plan to convert an oil rig escape boat into a comfortable floating holiday home. But without fixed plans, will they sink or swim?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E8 Ding Dong Merrily on Live Roped into organising a Christmas variety show to raise money for their children's school, Lee and Lucy find quality acts thin on the ground. Will Toby and Anna help out? What could possibly go wrong?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spooks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E8 MI5 is drawn into a high-profile investigation when the son of a rock star and pop icon is kidnapped.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Elementary
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E8 Sand Trap Holmes and Watson's search for the killer of a woman, found encased in cement, takes them inside the clean technology industry. Also, Watson takes a giant leap forward regarding her interest in adoption.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E7 No Brain, No Gain Benton keeps vigil on the baby whose critical condition is the result of his error and tries to save another brain-dead child. Susan's announcement about her future shocks Mark, and Ross seeks therapy for his sex addiction.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Fresh Off the Boat
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E22 Gotta Be Me Louis helps Emery become the cool kid at school and Jessica chaperones Eddie's field trip to Colonial Floridatowne, proving that she can be a fun mum.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E12 Intelligence Stephen Fry asks some intelligent questions to Jo Brand, David Mitchell, Phill Jupitus and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S15 E11 The Unseen Bits Rob Brydon, Lee Mack and David Mitchell return for an episode of previously unseen material. A stellar cast of celebrity guests reveal extraordinary stories about themselves. But are they true, or are they making it all up?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E18 Episode 18 It’s an episode of real genius, explosive action and dangerous driving. First Adam and Jamie take on the classic urban myth driving in the Rain.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Leeds Emma and Lee Fozard are in desperate need of Phil's property expertise. A couple with three young boys, Emma and Lee have outgrown their current home. But is it good enough to put on the market in its current state?

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E1 Disappearing Bathroom And Reliant Robin George Clarke meets a couple creating a disappearing bathroom and a man squeezing a camper into a Reliant Robin. He also discovers Chile's stunning architecture and plans his hardest ever build - an observatory.

ABCMESydney.au.title: House of Games ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E23 Episode 23 Johnny Ball, Suzi Ruffell, Nina Wadia and Danny Wallace test their general knowledge skills on this week's House of Games.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spicks and Specks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E13 Greg Larsen, Lucy Durack, Royston Noell & Sara Pascoe We ask if The Nutbush is Australia's national dance and Greg Larsen takes Substitute to a new level. Lucy Durack, Royston Noell and Sara Pascoe join Alan, Myf and Adam. Plus Ruva Ngwenya's closing number is simply the best!

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S23 E1 Wales, Whales and Wails Join Sandi Toksvig for a new season of QI as she considers Wales, Whales, and Wails with Elis James, Griff Rhys Jones, Kiri Pritchard-McLean and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S17 E4 Episode 4 Jack Carroll, Bridget Christie, Gabby Logan, and Big Zuu join host Rob Brydon and team captains Lee Mack and David Mitchell to sort out the fact from the fiction.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Death In Paradise
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E5 The team investigate the murder of an estate agent during the private sale of a picturesque beach and discover the buyers were victims of a scam. Meanwhile, Marlon leads a counterfeit goods case to impress the Commissioner.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Elementary ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E9 Nobody Lives Forever Holmes' former sobriety sponsor, Alfredo, asks for his help with an illegal endeavor in order to save his brother.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E8 Union Station Time and Cupid wait for no man as Mark battles to express his feelings to Susan on her last day in the ER. Doug and Charlie try to help a baby whose mother has vanished. Carol gets appointed to serve on a hospital committee.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E8 Ding Dong Merrily on Live Roped into organising a Christmas variety show to raise money for their children's school, Lee and Lucy find quality acts thin on the ground. Will Toby and Anna help out? What could possibly go wrong?

ABCMESydney.au.title: rage Vault: Stranger Things ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: E308 We're turning this week's instalment of the VAULT up to Eleven, with a show dedicated to the 80s soundtrack of the hit science fiction show Stranger Things.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Along Came A Spider
ABCMESydney.au.description: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal kidnaps a senator's young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Leeds Emma and Lee Fozard are in desperate need of Phil's property expertise. A couple with three young boys, Emma and Lee have outgrown their current home. But is it good enough to put on the market in its current state?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Fresh Off the Boat
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E22 Gotta Be Me Louis helps Emery become the cool kid at school and Jessica chaperones Eddie's field trip to Colonial Floridatowne, proving that she can be a fun mum.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E12 Intelligence Stephen Fry asks some intelligent questions to Jo Brand, David Mitchell, Phill Jupitus and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E6 Slow Love A lonely snail lookin' for love literally crashes into the treehouse and asks Finn and Jake for help.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Baby Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E17 Triple T Tigers The Bears meet three cool tiger brothers. Grizz wants to be just like the oldest Tiger, TK, but he may not be the best role model.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E37 Teen Titans Vroom Part: 1 In this episode of \.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E39 The Blossom Files Blossom's skepticism is put to the test when she believes she's encountered a space alien.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E9 The Dark Owl The school principal Mr Damocles gets akumatized into Dark Owl. Armed with high-tech gadgets, he wants to get revenge on Ladybug and Cat Noir, who've humiliated him. To stop him, our heroes will have to ruffle his feathers!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E4 The Band Gwen rushes to save Irene, who risks missing her important exam to play in Ron's band, while Felicity and June search for the missing time capsule.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Odd Squad
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E65 Drop Gadget Repeat Oona, Olympia and Otis try to escape from a time loop.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E21 I, Butler The Bears use a robot bear to help around the house.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Little Lunch
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E15 The Oval Most days, Rory kicks the ball over the fence, hits the council windows and is promptly sent to sit in the Principal's office. Today, he is trying very hard not to do that, by kicking the ball to the other kids instead.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E24 A Corphish Out of Water When Ash's rowdy new Corphish eats something it shouldn't, he goes on a dangerous journey to get it to the Pokemon Centre!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Transformers: Earthspark
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E24 The Battle of Witwicky The truth about the Terrans is revealed as the Malto family makes a last stand against Croft and her sinister forces within GHOST.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E11 Beyond This Earthly Realm When Finn finds a porcelain lamb, it transports him into the spirit world and only the Ice King can help get him out!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E34 Ones and Zeros The Titans build an AI robot that can create pizzas.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E39 Lucky Stars Raven explains astrology to the Titans and tells their horoscopes, but Cyborg does not believe.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E26 The Sorcerer Gumball refuses to accept he is the only kid at school that doesn't have special powers. He convinces Hector's mom to take him on as his apprentice but she soon learns leaving Gumball unsupervised around magic is a mistake.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E36 Gnomes Might Fly Twinkle, who prides herself on being the only flying hero, is upset by Herbert's flying invention, and the pair risk a quest by being too competitive.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E3 How to Shop Fed up with plankton, the crew is on edge. Cyril suggests a bold plan to get the red sauce humans use to flavor food. Jim eagerly agrees without thinking it through. Their supermarket mission quickly spirals out of control.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E20 That's A Wrap Duncan goes on a mission to scare Courtney during a field trip to the museum.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E22 Ephemeral What if Ladybug and Cat Noir found out about each other's secret identities?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Ninjago
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Rise of the Snakes The four Ninja are snapped out of their post-hero complacency when Lord Garmadon's young son Lloyd shows up and tries to pick up where his father left off.

ABCMESydney.au.title: City Island
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E16 Library Watt and Windy want the next book in a series they're reading, so they head to the library, where a friendly librarian shows them how the library works and how much it has to offer.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Colourblocks ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E16 Little Red Riding Hood Purple stages a version of Little Red Riding Hood but can the other Colourblocks stick to the story? Learn about colour mixing with the Colourblocks.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E16 Five's Super Sorter Numberblocks Five and Two are in their toy library, but all their favourite toys are in a mess. Can their new friend Sorty the Super Sorter help sort out their problem?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E19 The A-MAZE-ing Escape! The Shuffler traps the Super Readers in a high-tech maze!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E10 How is it Made? Colour Maddie is learning about colours and how by mixing the primary colours red, blue and yellow together, we can make new colours called secondary colours!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E16 Kakadu! Traditional Owners Connie and her granddaughter, Gleesyanna, take Clarence on a journey through Kakadu's incredible plant life and introduce him to the six seasons of Kakadu.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Horrible Histories
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E11 Tricky Queen Vicky We meet young Vicky as she becomes Queen aged only 18, marries her true love Albert, and has to put up with the open sewers at the not-so-luxurious Buckingham Palace.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Past to Present ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E4 Ancient Rome Discover the amazing world of ancient Rome, including incredible arches and amphitheatres, how Mars got its name and the founding myth of Rome itself.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Ancient World Greece
ABCMESydney.au.description: E4 Slavery When examining the wonders of ancient Greece, we need to acknowledge that many of its achievements were the result of slave labour. We examine the ancient Greek slave classes and their role in maintaining the economy.

ABCMESydney.au.title: BTN
ABCMESydney.au.description: E31 Episode 31 Amelia Moseley takes a look at some of the major news stories of the week and explains the issues and events for school aged Australians.

kdsm.us.title: Best Medicine ᴺᵉʷ
kdsm.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

kdsm.us.title: Doc ᴺᵉʷ
kdsm.us.description: After a brain injury erases the last eight years of Dr. Amy Larsen's life, she must navigate an unfamiliar world where she has no recollection of patients she's treated, colleagues she's crossed, the soulmate she divorced, the man she now loves or the tragedy that caused her to push everyone away. She can rely only on her estranged 17-year-old daughter, whom she remembers as a 9-year-old, and a handful of devoted friends, as she struggles to continue practicing medicine, despite having lost nearly a decade of knowledge and experience. (Drama, Medical) - 2025-01-07

kptv.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. wdrb.us.title: The Simpsons
wdrb.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

The half-hour program covers many aspects of farming to give producers the information they need to make better decisions about their operations. The show's not just about agriculture, though, as it also features regular segments that deal with topics such as food safety, health news, and the people and places of rural America. Anchor Clinton Griffiths leads the show's on-air team. (News, Agriculture)

wofl.us.title: Best Medicine ᴺᵉʷ
wofl.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

wofl.us.title: Doc ᴺᵉʷ
wofl.us.description: After a brain injury erases the last eight years of Dr. Amy Larsen's life, she must navigate an unfamiliar world where she has no recollection of patients she's treated, colleagues she's crossed, the soulmate she divorced, the man she now loves or the tragedy that caused her to push everyone away. She can rely only on her estranged 17-year-old daughter, whom she remembers as a 9-year-old, and a handful of devoted friends, as she struggles to continue practicing medicine, despite having lost nearly a decade of knowledge and experience. (Drama, Medical) - 2025-01-07

wxix.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. fxm.us.title: The Last Duel
fxm.us.description: Jean de Carrouges is a respected knight known for his bravery and skill on the battlefield. Jacques Le Gris is a squire whose intelligence and eloquence makes him one of the most admired nobles in court. When Le Gris viciously assaults Carrouges' wife, she steps forward to accuse her attacker, an act of bravery and defiance that puts her life in jeopardy. The ensuing trial by combat, a grueling duel to the death, places the fate of all three in God's hands. (Historical drama) - 2021

fxm.us.title: Jojo Rabbit
fxm.us.description: Jojo is a lonely German boy who discovers that his single mother is hiding a Jewish girl in their attic. Aided only by his imaginary friend -- Adolf Hitler -- Jojo must confront his blind nationalism as World War II continues to rage on. (Comedy drama, Dark comedy) - 2019
